about: The guides' author's words that the pilot page uses as its own text (since v3 the page does not put his words in quotation marks: owner's review 355), each with a checked source that holds it word for word. tests/healthy-living-pilot.test.ts fails if an entry is missing from the page. With ASKRIGOR_PILOT_QUOTE_SOURCES set to the folder holding the sources, it also checks each entry against its source. The exact quotations, and every place where the page differs from the guides, are in the release folder's pilot-v3/changes-from-guides.md.
